items.difficulty_reason: 92 行、七条等价条件的大命题。证明分三段：①用标准的 Hom/Ext/derived Hom/对偶识别把 (2)–(6) 归成一块，并给出 (1)⇒(2)；②借「生成元即经典生成元」把「RHom 有下界」这类性质从 G 推到所有 perfect 对象（性质对直和/直和项/位移封闭、满足三选二）；③剩下的 (2)–(7)⇒(1) 用拟紧开集归纳：仿射情形用结构层当测试对象 + 「E 由 RΓ 决定」，并集情形要**构造**一个以某个 Koszul 复形为模型的 perfect 复形 K'、用正交性引理得到截断同构、再借归纳与「直接像保持下有界」收尾。引用 15 处（8 同章、7 跨章）但构造与截断论证都在 span 内；作者在推性质那段写了一句 `Small detail omitted.`，已按规则逐字记入 editorial_notes。判 H3（体量与依赖度）。

primary.label: author proposition environment with its own label proposition-detecting-bounded-below (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 10834-10857

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the proposition: the equivalence of the seven conditions by the standard Hom and dual identifications, the extension from the given generator to all perfect complexes by the classical generator argument, and the induction on quasi-compact opens that finishes the converse (source lines 10859-10950)
